caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven fabric, primarily in light beige with three vertical navy blue stripes. The central blue stripe is the widest, flanked on either side by narrower blue stripes, all of which run parallel and occupy the middle section of the fabric. The weave of the fabric shows a herringbone pattern, with the beige and blue threads interlacing diagonally. The edges of the fabric panel are finished with a short fringe in the same beige color. The fabric sample is centered on a plain, light background. Below the fabric, the words "WOOLEN BLANKET" appear in fine, uppercase letters in the left corner, and there is a signature "Wm T. Parkinson" in the bottom right corner.
title: Striped Kersey
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
